author: jsign
content:
Thanks. I'm pretty sure this is related that in EEST we use Geth as the benchmark filler (since Python is too slow for big gas limit -- this is is the case for normal benchmarks or zkEVM benchmarks). Today, Geth isn't quite aligned in passing executionWitness tests so there is a reasonable chance they have some bugs/differences. Feel free to pass me whatever you find though.

I'm planning to probably switch to Ethrex for EEST benchmark fixture generation in the short/medium term, which is following  closer the executionWitness generation test passing -- already did some exploration on EEST and Ethrex changes for this. I think this prob will resolve whatever you saw, since if the stateless guest program pass with Geth witness, it might be because it adds more than needed (if not, it would fail).
